spans.s: edṛśa, f. ˚śā, ˚śī, adj. (= Pali edisa, Skt. īd˚; Pischel 〔121〕 has a highly implausible explanation of e-; Geiger 〔11〕 a less implausible one), such; very common in Mv but rare elsewhere: SP 〔70.7〕 (vs; īdṛśa in same position 〔70.4〕); 〔336.7〕 (vs); Mv 〔i.225.8〕 and (˚śī, f., by em.) 9, 〔258.21〕 and 〔261.14〕 (˚śāye, inst. f.); 〔284.9〕; 〔289.1〕; 〔308.16〕 (˚śāye); 〔364.8〕; 〔ii.35.3〕; 〔58.10〕 (˚śī); 〔76.16〕; 〔110.1〕; 〔144.17〕; 〔146.13〕; 〔147.15〕 (˚śī); 〔180.1〕; 〔208.16〕; 〔215.14, 15〕; 〔274.9〕; 〔307.18〕; 〔433.2〕; 〔447.3〕; 〔iii.130.15〕; 〔264.6 f.〕, etc.
edṛśaka (= Pali edisaka), = edṛśa, such: Mv 〔ii.7.7〕 (vs; v.l. edṛśaṃ; meter is bad either way); 〔ii.35.2〕 (vs; here -ka may be m.c.).
